clips.title: The story
paras: Wanted: Arnak Grimtotem is a Horde bounty posted at Freewind Post demanding the execution of a violent Grimtotem exile. Arnak is targeted by the local authorities for murder and kidnapping on the mesas above the canyon.

While tensions between the mainstream tauren of the Horde and the reclusive Grimtotem tribe are perpetually strained, Arnak took matters far beyond political friction. Branded an outcast, Arnak murdered a tauren and abducted the victim's sister, Lakota Windsong. In response to these heinous acts, Cliffwatcher Longhorn of Freewind Post sanctioned an open bounty calling for the rogue tauren's death.

Arnak took refuge upon the high crags of Darkcloud Pinnacle, an extensive network of rope bridges and mesa encampments occupied by the Grimtotem clan near the entrance to Razorfen Downs. Trapped upon these windswept heights alongside Arnak is his captive, Lakota Windsong, awaiting rescue from anyone brave enough to fight across the Grimtotem bridges.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Arnak the outcast is wanted for the heinous crimes of murder and kidnapping. Handsome rewards will be given to those brave enough to bring this criminal to justice.
Arnak was last seen on the cliffs near the Darkcloud Pinnacle. Show the proof of your deed to Cliffwatcher Longhorn in Freewind Post in order to claim the reward.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Have you any news of that murderous Arnak Grimtotem?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Hah! Well, this is excellent news! I was starting to think that he would never be brought to justice!
Here you are, friend... And thanks. News of Arnak's foul deeds boiled my blood!
